# CANDIDATE: ORB_DIRECTION_FILTER_UPDATE

**Filed:** 2026-07-16
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Testing if the long-only filter (ORB_DIRECTION_FILTER) improves edge capture and Sharpe by avoiding short-term losers, particularly on J's loser days, while preserving the ability to capture J's winner days through long trades on those days (if applicable). However, given J's winner days are put-based, we expect the long-only filter to skip winner trades, potentially reducing edge capture.

## Mechanism

The ORB_DIRECTION_FILTER gate, when enabled in the watcher, suppresses all short (put) signal emissions, resulting in the engine only receiving long (call) signals. Entry logic remains unchanged: the engine takes the first long signal that passes other filters. Exit logic remains unchanged (chart-stop primary, with profit-lock and time stop).
